🔤 Typography

Font families, sizes, weights and line heights for every text style used across Iron Software products.

The name on this page is the name in Figma and the name in code. Every style below is named for its CSS variable suffix — title-lg is --font-size-title-lg and the Tailwind utility text-title-lg, and it is the name it carries in Figma’s text-style panel. Aligned 2026-08-06; there is nothing to translate.

Font Family
Montserrat

Montserrat — Content & UI

One family for everything: 16 content levels (H1 → Code) and 9 UI levels (buttons, nav). The page requests 400–900, so every weight below is real — no fake-bold. Hierarchy is driven by weight and size together: the levels use 400 through 800, four of them at 800 and eight at 700. 900 is downloaded but no token uses it — it was h1-hero’s weight until 2026-08-17.

Regular 400 Medium 500 Semibold 600 Bold 700 Extrabold 800 Black 900

UI Scale — Buttons & Navigation

UI text reuses the 16 / 14 / 12 px content sizes but sets its own weight (600 buttons, 500 nav) and a tight line-height of 1, so it reads as interactive rather than as prose.
